# How Add-ons increase your API and Automation limits

Podio and Podio Workflow Automation each include a base amount of usage at no extra cost. When your usage grows beyond that base amount, an add-on increases the limit for the specific API key or Automation Account that needs it. This article explains how those limits work and how an add-on changes them.

## Base limits included with your plan

Every API key and Automation Account starts with a base limit included in your plan, at no additional cost:

- API keys include up to 250 API calls per hour for Limit A and up to 1,000 API calls per hour for Limit B.
- Automation Accounts on a Premium plan include up to 25,000 actions per month.

> **Note:**
>
> These base limits apply automatically. You don't need to do anything to use them, and you're never charged extra for staying within them.

## How an add-on changes your limit

When you purchase an add-on for an **API** key or an **Automation Account**, its limit is raised to the level included with that add-on, replacing the base limit for as long as the add-on is active.

For example, if an API key's base limits are **250** calls per hour for **Limit A** and **1,000** calls per hour for **Limit B**, and you purchase an add-on that provides **500** calls per hour for **Limit A** and **2,500** calls per hour for **Limit B**, the **API** key can make up to **500** calls per hour (**Limit A**) and **2,500** calls per hour (**Limit B**) while the add-on remains active.

> **Note:**
>
> The increased limit applies immediately once the add-on purchase completes — there's no waiting period.

![Add ons increase api](/podio/documentation/assets/5dcd1e3ac6bea8eab81f7abe7313031f/adds-on-incr-api1a.png)

## What happens when you cancel an add-on

Canceling an add-on doesn't remove its increased limit right away. The higher limit remains in place until the end of your current billing period, so your **API** key or **Automation Account** keeps working at the higher capacity through the time you already paid for. Once that period ends, the limit automatically returns to the base amount included with your plan.

See [Canceling an add-on](/podio/documentation/using-podio/upgrade-and-billing/cancelling-add-ons) for full details on this grace period.

### Purchasing a different add-on tier

An API key or Automation Account can only have one active add-on at a time. If you need more capacity than your current add-on provides, you upgrade to a higher add-on instead of purchasing a second one. See Upgrading an add-on for details.

## Checking your current usage

Before deciding whether you need an add-on, you can review how close your **API** keys and **Automation Account** are to their limits:

- **API usage** — API key owners can review usage from the API Keys settings page.

![Add ons increase api](/podio/documentation/assets/57cda8d81dbd1a403507fdf68132e734/adds-on-incr-api1b.png)
- **Automation usage** — Automation account owners can review usage from the Workflow Automation Account Details page.

![Add ons increase api](/podio/documentation/assets/3f04d21f3d2a3bd88b180559ea457ea7/adds-on-incr-api1c.png)

Organization **Admins** and **Service Users** can also review usage for org members who have an active or still-valid canceled add-on from the add-ons and usage dashboard — see [Add-ons and usage dashboard for organization admins](/podio/documentation/using-podio/upgrade-and-billing/add-ons-and-usage-dashboard). Members who are still on their base limits (no add-on purchased) are not shown on that dashboard.
